rna.text: Olrich, Kodolaag's friend, agrees to host Zita's effigy sales at the Mockturne after Kodolaag promises him an audience at Rix Maadi, and he then joins Kodolaag in visiting the precognition mage Lucinka, who gives them instructions for freeing Zita.

At Udzec, Olrich dresses as a baby and swallows the bloodfray amulet while Kodolaag frames the minotaur Jitka Wothis to distract the nullmages, and later Olrich impersonates Dovin Baan to hold off a soldier so the trio can walk out among exiting visitors.

Jitka Wothis and a vampire identify Kodolaag and Olrich, who are bound by magic and put to forced labor at the Exner prison site, where Kodolaag has Olrich cough up the amulet and shatters it, triggering a massive riot.
Lucinka tells Zita, Olrich and Kodolaag they can never return to their old lives and should form a troupe in the undercity to hunt dangerous escapees.
